## `client.terms`

The `terms` resource of the platform API: the glossary of an environment.

### `client.terms.list`

Signature: `client.terms.list(environment: str, *, owner: str | None = None, repository: str | None = None, lang: str | None = None, limit: int | None = None, cursor: str | None = None) -> TermPage`

List one page of an environment's glossary terms, sorted by key.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment. |
| `owner` | `str | None` | `None` | Only terms with exactly this owner. |
| `repository` | `str | None` | `None` | Only terms this repository defines. |
| `lang` | `str | None` | `None` | Show the texts in this language, such as ``de`` or ``fr-CH``; your profile's language by default. |
| `limit` | `int | None` | `None` | Most terms returned (1 to 200); `None` leaves it to the server (100). |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | A previous page's `next_cursor`. |

Returns: `TermPage`. The terms, and the cursor of the next page (`None` on the last).

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the environment does not exist, or the server has no glossary routes. |

### `client.terms.iter`

Signature: `client.terms.iter(environment: str, *, owner: str | None = None, repository: str | None = None, lang: str | None = None, page_size: int = 100) -> Iterator[Term]`

Yield every term of an environment, sorted by key, fetching pages as needed.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment. |
| `owner` | `str | None` | `None` | Only terms with exactly this owner. |
| `repository` | `str | None` | `None` | Only terms this repository defines. |
| `lang` | `str | None` | `None` | Show the texts in this language. |
| `page_size` | `int` | `100` | Terms per request (1 to 200). |

Returns: `Iterator of Term`. Each term, once.

### `client.terms.get`

Signature: `client.terms.get(environment: str, key: str, *, lang: str | None = None) -> Term`

Show a glossary term.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment. |
| `key` | `str` | required | The term's id in the glossary. |
| `lang` | `str | None` | `None` | Show the texts in this language. |

Returns: `Term`. The term.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the environment or the term does not exist. |
